rv.q: Although the escape routines don’t necessarily align with the sins exactly, there are loose connections (you’ll remember the stunts more than the themes).
Marta Lucata (concept and script) and director Alberto Oliva fail to stir up any sense of thematic urgency.
Most of the magic is mediocre, the contraptions can be confusing, and Lord Nil’s celebrations are right out of professional wrestling.

cn.t: Italian escapologist Lord Nil's Broadway debut delivers TV-style spectacle but falls short theatrically, with critics finding the America's Got Talent alum's fear-facing stunts more suited to small screen than stage.
